claims.text: The driver's own trace shows he held position inside the pickup geofence for a continuous 440 seconds, which exceeds the 180-second free waiting period in force for this STANDARD-zone trip, so POL-NS-01 limb (c) is satisfied on the driver's evidence.

The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 10:43:34 and a wait_timer_started event at 10:43:36, and the driver terminated the trip at 10:50:57 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the three codes POL-NS-01 limb (d) recognises.

The rider's only message, sent at 10:44:14, says 'im at the pickup, cant see you' and was never read (read_at is null) and never answered; the driver posted no reply and placed no in-app call, so the rider's own account confirms she was not in the vehicle when the driver cancelled.

The fare ledger shows the cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 was charged and no refund has been issued, and the driver's compensation under POL-NS-07 is 80 percent of that net fee, SGD 3.60, which the ledger itself computes.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0, which is below the 4-or-more limb, and 0 divided by completed_trips_30d of 70 is 0.0, which is not greater than 0.08, so compensation is payable and the fee stands.

The rider's own profile shows no_show_disputes_30d of 0 and disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 0, so neither POL-NS-09(d) nor POL-NS-09(c) is engaged and there is no basis to escalate this case to human review.

The rider's claim that she 'messaged and he never replied' does not by itself exonerate her: POL-NS-04 requires the rider's device to be placed within 100 m of the pin for the majority of qualifying fixes, and the trace carries no rider track at all, so limb (c) is undecidable under POL-NS-11 and POL-NS-04 cannot be run in her favour.

The rider's assertion that the driver never showed up is contradicted by the driver's trace, which places him stationary in the geofence from 10:43:34 to 10:50:54, and by the platform's own wait-timer events; the rider's message at 10:44:14 is consistent with her being at the pickup but not boarding, not with the driver being absent.

The traffic advisory artifact is MISSING with weight 0.0, so POL-NS-06 limb (i) is unavailable and no accumulation of separate in-geofence intervals can be claimed; the single 440-second run stands on its own and is more than sufficient.

The rider's filing is a NO_SHOW_CHARGE dispute filed by the rider, so under POL-GEN-03 a NO_ACTION ruling leaves the SGD 4.50 charge in place and the rider's claim unsupported; the driver's compensation of SGD 3.60 is the outcome the case produces.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties — Rider RDR-09758 and Driver DRV-09758. This decides the SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee charged for trip TRP-02758 on 16 August 2026. The fee stands, the driver is compensated SGD 3.60, and no referral issues. Because the ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, the amount_sgd figure (SGD 3.60) is the same as the driver-compensation figure: it is the amount this ruling moves, not a second payment and not a refund to the rider (POL-GEN-03).

Why the fee stands. POL-NS-01 requires four conditions and all four are met on the record. (a) The trip record EV-TRIP-02758 carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 10:43:34. (b) The GPS trace EV-GPS-02758 places him inside the 50 m STANDARD-zone pickup geofence at 10:43:34 — the first in-geofence fix carries that same timestamp — and reports 45 qualifying in-geofence fixes, so the POL-NS-02 arrival test is met. (c) He held position there continuously for 440 seconds, from 10:43:34 to 10:50:54, against the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180 s; the computed shortfall is −260 s, i.e. a surplus of 260 s). (d) No boarding is recorded and he terminated the trip at 10:50:57 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW — one of the three codes limb (d) recognises — well after the required dwell elapsed.

No rider-side clause displaces the fee. POL-NS-03 does not apply: the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, not outside it, so this is not a wrong-entrance case. POL-NS-05 does not fire: the 'arrived' marker is not false, because the first in-geofence fix is at the marker's own timestamp and the driver was stationary rather than travelling at 15 km/h or more, so no false-arrival referral arises. POL-NS-06 does not apply: the 440-second dwell exceeds the 180-second minimum, so there is no shortfall to refund, and the missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02758-01 (weight 0.0) is beside the point because no separate in-geofence intervals need summing.

Your message, Rider. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate you. Two of its three limbs hold — you sent a locating message at 10:44:14 ('im at the pickup, cant see you') and the driver neither replied within 120 seconds nor made an in-app call — but limb (c) could not be run at all, because the trace carries no rider track (rider_fix_count 0). Under POL-NS-11 that limb is undecidable and neutral, so POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate you and the fee is decided on the driver's own evidence. The unanswered message is not held against you; it simply cannot carry the test that would have helped you. Your filing that the driver 'never showed up' is contradicted by the trace and the platform's own wait-timer events.

Compensation. POL-NS-07 sets the driver's payout at 80% of the SGD 4.50 fee in force — SGD 3.60 — the residual 20% being the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip: no_show_terminations_30d = 0 (below the 4-or-more limb) and 0 ÷ 70 completed trips = 0.00 (not above 0.08). The fare ledger EV-FARE-02758 shows the fee charged (cancellation_fee 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) and reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd = 4.50, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect.

Confidence and review. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: no admissible artifacts contradict each other; no repeat-party pattern (both disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0 and rider no_show_disputes_30d is 0); the anti-farming limb does not trip; and no deciding fact rests on an artifact impaired under POL-NS-08(a)–(d) — the trace has 100% coverage, no gap over 120 s and 92 fixes, and the chat log matches chat_message_count = 1 with intact sequence numbering. Confidence is 0.90, above the 0.70 floor; the cap is 1.00, since the deciding facts are carried by EV-GPS-02758, EV-TRIP-02758 and EV-FARE-02758, each at weight 1.00. Two claims citing the missing advisory were discarded by the referee for not naming its issue code; they are recorded in the audit and carry no weight here.

The monetary effect (SGD 3.60) is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes on issue. Either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

ruling.explanation:
This ruling concerns the SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02758, which the rider disputes on the ground that she messaged and got no reply.

The fee stands. POL-NS-01 requires four things and all four are on the record. (a) The trip record carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 10:43:34. (b) The GPS trace places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD-zone arrival radius at that same moment: the derived longest qualifying in-geofence run begins at 10:43:34 and contains 45 consecutive qualifying fixes on a 100%-coverage, 10-second trace with no gaps. (c) The driver held position for a continuous 440 seconds, well past the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180). (d) No boarding event is recorded and the driver terminated the trip at 10:50:57 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is 440 seconds after the clock started, i.e. at or after the required dwell elapsed. POL-NS-02 is therefore met. POL-NS-05 does not bite: the arrival marker is not false, because at the marker timestamp the driver was stationary inside the geofence, not more than 300 m from the pin and not travelling at 15 km/h or more. POL-NS-06 does not apply either: the dwell exceeded the minimum, so there is no shortfall and no refund of the fee. POL-NS-03 is not in play, the driver's stationary fixes being inside the 50 m radius rather than outside it but within 400 m.

The rider's contact point. The chat log shows one message from the rider at 10:44:14 ('im at the pickup, cant see you'), never read, and the driver neither replied within 120 seconds nor placed an in-app call. That is the contact route of POL-NS-04, which would exonerate the rider, but limb (c) of that clause requires the rider's own device to be placed within 100 m of the pin for the majority of qualifying fixes, and the GPS trace carries no rider track at all. Under POL-NS-04 and POL-NS-11 that limb is undecidable — neither satisfied nor failed — so POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider, and the test could not be run rather than the rider being inferred elsewhere. POL-NS-11 is explicit that the missing rider track does not impair the driver's trace for arrival or dwell, does not by itself engage POL-NS-08(b) or POL-NS-09(e), and does not lower the POL-GEN-02 confidence cap; the dispute is decided on the driver's own evidence.

Driver compensation. Under POL-NS-07 the driver is paid 80% of the cancellation fee in force: 0.8 x SGD 4.50 = SGD 3.60, the figure the fare ledger itself computes. The anti-farming check does not trip — driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0 (below the 4-or-more limb) and 0 divided by 70 completed trips is 0.0 (not above 0.08) — so compensation is paid rather than withheld. Because the case produces a driver payment, the ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION and, per POL-GEN-03, amount_sgd carries the same SGD 3.60; the charge to the rider stands and the rider's claim is not supported. The fare reconciliation is clean: the SGD 4.50 cancellation-fee line equals the SGD 4.50 platform_policy figure, so no POL-NS-08(d) defect arises.

The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02758-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0) and has no effect on the outcome: its absence only makes POL-NS-06 limb (i) unavailable, and no accumulation of separate in-geofence intervals was needed because the single 440-second run already exceeds the minimum. Confidence rests on EV-TRIP-02758 and EV-GPS-02758, both at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and the finding survives undiscounted. No escalation trigger under POL-NS-09 fires — confidence is above the 0.70 floor, no admissible artifacts contradict on arrival, dwell or rider presence, and the counterparty history and anti-farming fields are all at zero — and no clause produces a referral. The monetary effect of SGD 3.60 is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so the ruling executes automatically.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: your SGD 4.50 cancellation fee stands, and the driver is paid SGD 3.60 (80% of that fee) out of it — you are not charged twice. To the driver: your no-show fee is upheld and your payout is confirmed. This is a rider-filed dispute, so 'no refund' is the outcome for you; the ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION because that is the outcome the case produces (POL-GEN-03, POL-NS-07).

Why the charge stands. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold on the record. (a) trip_record EV-TRIP-02758 carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 10:43:34. (b) gps_trace EV-GPS-02758 places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD-zone arrival radius at 10:43:34 — the same timestamp — with 45 qualifying in-geofence fixes forming one continuous run; POL-NS-02's geofence test (3+ consecutive in-radius fixes) is therefore met from the driver's own track. (c) the continuous dwell was 440 seconds (10:43:34 to 10:50:54), against the free waiting period in force of 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180, matching the STANDARD minimum_dwell_sec). (d) the trip was terminated by the driver at 10:50:57 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the dwell elapsed, with no boarding event recorded.

The displacing clauses are tested and do not fire. POL-NS-05: the arrival marker is not false — at 10:43:34 the driver was stationary at the pin (min distance 0 m) and not travelling at or above 15 km/h. POL-NS-06: there is no shortfall — 440 s exceeds the 180 s minimum by 260 s (derived shortfall_sec −260 s), so the refund route does not open. POL-NS-03 does not apply because the stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, not outside it. POL-NS-10 does not apply: this was the driver's cancellation, not the rider's.

Your message, rider, does not win the case. Your 10:44:14 chat message ('im at the pickup, cant see you') is locating, and the driver neither replied within 120 s nor placed an in-app call (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty), so POL-NS-04 limbs (a) and (b) hold. But limb (c) requires the gps_trace rider_track to place your device within 100 m of the pin, and the trace carries no rider track at all. Under POL-NS-11 that limb is UNDECIDABLE — neither satisfied nor failed — so POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate you, and the fee is decided on the driver's evidence. The missing rider_track is not the evidence for the driver's arrival or dwell and does not by itself engage POL-NS-08(b) or POL-NS-09(e).

Compensation (POL-NS-07). The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0 (below 4) and 0 ÷ 70 completed_trips_30d = 0.0 (not above 0.08). Compensation is therefore 80% of the SGD 4.50 net fee = SGD 3.60, the figure the fare ledger (EV-FARE-02758, derived.money.driver_compensation = 3.60) itself computes; 20% is retained as the platform service fee.

No escalation. Confidence in the deciding facts is 0.90, above the 0.70 floor. POL-NS-09 is not engaged: no clause conflicts; rider and driver disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0; the anti-farming check does not trip; and no artifact carrying a deciding fact is impaired under POL-NS-08(a)–(d) — the trace has 0 s max gap and 92 fixes, the chat sequence is intact at 1 of 1 messages, the fare line reconciles to the SGD 4.50 net fee, and there is no clock skew (the arrival event and the first in-geofence fix share the 10:43:34 timestamp).

The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02758-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0). Both advocates' claims resting on it were discarded by the referee for undisclosing that impairment, and its absence changes nothing here: the dwell is a single continuous 440-second run, so POL-NS-06(i) accumulation across intervals is not needed. The driver's counterparty statement ('Waited the full period') is consistent with the trace but carries no weight of its own.

Money used: cancellation fee SGD 4.50 (EV-FARE-02758, total_charged 4.50, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) and the 0.80 driver compensation rate, giving SGD 3.60. The monetary effect (SGD 3.60) is below the SGD 8.00 automatic execution threshold (POL-GEN-05), so it executes on issue. No clause produces a referral on these facts, so the referrals list is empty.
